title: Componentwise gluing for the coherent-family module presheaf
statement: For a ringed space X, arbitrary opens U indexed by I, local module sheaves Fi, and arbitrary overlap isomorphisms φij, suppose the coherent-family submodules of def-weil-pbc-module-compatible-family-presheaf on all opens are small in max u v. Then the underlying abelian-group presheaf of smallCoherentOpenModulePresheaf is a sheaf for Opens.grothendieckTopology X. No cover, diagonal, or cocycle hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tags 00AL (first proof) and 00AM; point-indexed universe argument of parent node

proof.text: For a covering sieve S on V and a matching family of coherent families, restrict S to any W contained in V and U i, then transfer that covering sieve to Over (U i). Its local sections are obtained by evaluating the matching family on its domains. Matching-family coherence and local restriction coherence prove compatibility. The sheaf axiom of Fi gives the unique amalgamation component on W.

Separation on each induced covering sieve shows these amalgamation components respect restriction, using presheaf map composition. Naturality of φij and the given families overlap equations show the amalgamation respects overlaps. Evaluation on a sieve member recovers its given family; separation componentwise proves uniqueness. Thus the large coherent-family Type presheaf is a sheaf.

Presieve.isSheaf_of_nat_equiv transports the Type sheaf condition through the sectionwise shrinking equivalences. smallCoherentOpenModulePresheaf_map_equiv supplies their naturality. Reflection of limits by the forgetful functor from abelian groups then proves the stated abelian-group sheaf condition.

lean.statement:
theorem small_coherent_open_module_isSheaf
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (I : Type w) (U : I → Opens X)
  (Fi : ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.{max u v} ((moduleRings X).over (U i)))
  (φij : ∀ i j : I,
    (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U i)).obj (Fi i) ≅
    (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U j)).obj (Fi j))
    [∀ V : Opens X, Small.{max u v} (coherentOpenModuleSubmodule X I U Fi φij V)] :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (smallCoherentOpenModulePresheaf X I U Fi φij).presheaf
